description:
Gmail API - Complete email management with SMART bundled tools for AI-powered composition, bulk operations, inbox organization, and intelligent processing.

⚠️ CRITICAL: ALL Gmail tools MUST be called through the execute_tool meta-tool. DO NOT call Gmail tools directly. If you try to call a Gmail tool directly, you will receive an authentication error. Always use: execute_tool(tool_name='gmail_xxx', ...parameters)

tools.name: gmail_ai_smart_compose_and_send
tools.description:
⚠️ MUST USE: execute_tool(tool_name='gmail_ai_smart_compose_and_send', ...) - DO NOT call directly!

Example response:
Created: **New Document**
- ID: `abc123`
- URL: https://example.com/doc/abc123
- Link: [New Document](https://example.com/doc/abc123)

🤖 SMART TOOL: AI-powered email composition and sending in ONE call. Takes natural language prompt, generates professional email, and sends or creates draft. Optionally creates Google Calendar events from email content. Use this instead of manually writing emails.

prompt.description: Natural language description of what to write. Examples: 'Follow up with John about yesterday's product launch meeting', 'Thank the team for Q4 performance', 'Apologize to customer for order #12345 delay'

recipients.description: List of email addresses to send to

send_immediately.description: If true, sends email. If false, creates draft for review.

create_calendar_event.description: If true, extracts date/time from email and creates Google Calendar event

use_cases: Send AI-generated follow-up emails
Compose and send meeting requests with calendar events
Create professional apology/thank you emails
Draft emails for review before sending

tools.name: gmail_get_message
tools.description:
⚠️ MUST USE: execute_tool(tool_name='gmail_get_message', ...) - DO NOT call directly!

Get a specific message by ID. Returns message metadata (from, to, subject, date, snippet) by default. Use format='full' only when user explicitly asks for full email content/body.

WARNING: format='full' returns large data (HTML body, headers, attachments). Use 'metadata' for browsing multiple emails.

format.description: Response format: 'metadata' (subject/from/to/date/snippet - RECOMMENDED for browsing), 'minimal' (IDs only), 'full' (complete message with body - LARGE, use sparingly)

tools.name: gmail_get_message_parsed
tools.description:
⚠️ MUST USE: execute_tool(tool_name='gmail_get_message_parsed', ...) - DO NOT call directly!

Get message with AI-OPTIMIZED parsing (clean text, parsed attachments). THIS IS THE RECOMMENDED METHOD when you need full email content.

What this does:
- Fetches full email content
- Converts HTML to clean text
- Parses attachments (PDF/Word/Excel) into text
- Returns structured JSON OR PDF (for Claude document API)

Output formats:
- 'json' (default): Returns structured data (1-2k tokens vs 50k!)
- 'pdf': Returns PDF bytes ready for Claude document API with smart header/footer detection

Use this instead of gmail_get_message(format='full') when:
- User wants to analyze email content
- User asks about attachments
- User needs to understand conversation context

Do NOT use this for:
- Browsing/listing emails (use gmail_list_messages)
- Quick previews (use gmail_get_message with format='metadata')

message_id.description: Gmail message ID to retrieve and parse

include_attachments.description: Whether to download and parse attachments (default: true). Set to false for faster responses if attachments not needed.

output_format.description: Output format: 'json' (default, structured data) or 'pdf' (for Claude document API with header/footer detection)

properties.subject: string
properties.attachments: array of {filename: str, content_type: str, size_bytes: int, parsed_content: str}
properties.token_estimate: int (rough token count for AI context)

examples.description: Get email with full content and attachments parsed

tools.name: gmail_get_thread_parsed
tools.description:
⚠️ MUST USE: execute_tool(tool_name='gmail_get_thread_parsed', ...) - DO NOT call directly!

Get entire email thread with conversation timeline and parsed content. Use this when user asks to:
- 'Show me the conversation'
- 'What's the email thread about?'
- 'Read this email chain'
- 'Understand the context'

Output formats:
- 'json' (default): Returns structured timeline with message previews
- 'pdf': Returns comprehensive PDF with entire thread, all messages, and attachments (RECOMMENDED for Claude analysis)

PDF format benefits:
- Entire thread in context
- Smart header/footer detection (extracts text from signatures/logos)
- All attachments inline
- Preserves conversation flow
- ~7k tokens per 3 pages

For full content of individual messages, use gmail_get_message_parsed with the message IDs from the timeline.

thread_id.description: Gmail thread ID (from gmail_list_messages or gmail_get_message)

max_messages.description: Maximum number of messages to fetch (default: 20)

output_format.description: Output format: 'json' (default, timeline structure) or 'pdf' (comprehensive PDF for Claude document API)

properties.subject: string
properties.messages: array of {position: int, from: object, date: str, body_text: str (preview), full_message_id: str}
